blocks.text: Beryllium (Be) ke siwa Group 2 ki baqi metals paani se react kar ke metal hydroxides, M(OH)₂, aur hydrogen gas (H₂) banati hain. Beryllium (Be) garam karne par bhi paani ya steam (bhaap) se react nahi karta. Is ki wajah us par chadhi protective (hifazati) oxide layer hai.
Magnesium (Mg) thande paani se bohat aahista react karta hai aur Mg(OH)₂ aur H₂ banata hai. Bhaap ke saath yeh tezi se react kar ke magnesium oxide (MgO) aur hydrogen banata hai.

Calcium (Ca) thande paani aur bhaap dono se magnesium ke muqable mein zyada tezi (vigorously) se react karta hai aur Ca(OH)₂ aur H₂ banata hai. Calcium hydroxide paani mein bohat kam ghulta (sparingly soluble) hai, is liye safaid precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) ban jata hai.

Group 2 ke hydroxides Group 1 ke muqable mein kam basic hain. Lekin group mein neeche jate hue Group 2 hydroxides ka basic character barhta hai, kyunke in ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) barhti hai.

blocks.alt: Graduated beaker (nishanon wala beaker) (25, 50 aur 75 ke nishan) jis mein doodhiya safaid gadla liquid hai, oopar jhaag hai aur neeche se gas ke bulbule oopar uth rahe hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.3: Calcium paani ke saath thora ghulne wala hydroxide banata hai (kitab ki Figure 17.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bulbule hydrogen gas ke hain: Ca(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂ + H₂(g). Paani doodhiya is liye hai ke Ca(OH)₂ thora sa hi ghulta hai; baqi safaid precipitate ban kar paani mein phail jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab equations mein Mg(OH)₂ aur Ca(OH)₂ ke saath (aq) likhti hai, lekin yeh dono bohat kam ghulte hain (Table 17.4). Is liye asal mein in ka zyada hissa solid (s) shakal mein precipitate ban kar milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium bhaap se thande paani ke muqable mein tez kyun react karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Bhaap bohat zyada garam hoti hai, is liye molecules ke paas zyada energy hoti hai aur reaction tez hota hai; is mein MgO aur H₂ bante hain.

items: Be: paani ya bhaap se koi reaction nahi (hifazati oxide layer).
Mg: thande paani se bohat aahista (Mg(OH)₂ + H₂), bhaap se tez (MgO + H₂).
Ca: tez reaction; Ca(OH)₂ kam ghulta hai aur safaid precipitate banata hai.
Hydroxides ka basic character group mein neeche barhta hai.
